title: A Job in the Sun
lines: Raj and Mom are in the hot fog.
A jet is up in the sun.
Raj has a jug and a mug.
Raj tugs and tugs. The jug is in the fog.
"Do not tug at the jug," said Mom.
Raj dips the mug in the jug.
Raj and Mom sit and look at the jet.
scoring_note: Decodability forbids apostrophes, so this text is written in uncontracted forms. A child who reads "can't" for "can not", "don't" for "do not" or "let's" for "let us" is reading for meaning and MUST NOT be scored an error.
